title: the ruling intake retires and decisions/ stays a read-only record
intention: The old ruling intake is deleted: the ruling machine, /ruled and the two bin commands are gone, decisions/ stays a read-only record the tester reads itself, and nothing live names them.
why: Akien's outline answer Q#43 (2026-11-06), at 17.12 of CairnComponentOutline[BACKUP].txt: 'ruling: the old ruling intake. Retired 2026-09-14 for questions; decisions/ stays read-only. Its code is deleted (1.2.7; Q#43, Akien 2026-11-06).' And 5.10.8: 'Retired already: ... ruling and ruled (→ question)'.
how: Extend the shared retirement proof with three teeth (red first); delete the machine, the skill, both commands and the host link; reseal reads decisions/ itself; proofs drop their ruling teeth; citations, comments, charters and prose stop naming the intake as live.

clauses.claim: cairn/machines/ruling, skills/ruled, bin/cmd/ruling, bin/cmd/ruled and ~/.claude/skills/ruled are absent
no repo file outside records of truth and caches names cairn.machines.ruling, cairn/machines/ruling, bin/cmd/ruling, bin/cmd/ruled, skills.ruled, skills/ruled, `cairn ruling` or `cairn ruled`
importing cairn.machines.ruling and skills.ruled.door each exits nonzero with No module named

decisions.text: D1: extend the red-first proof bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py with PROVES['640a7a48e1c5'] = {'1': 'ruling_paths_are_absent', '2': 'nothing_names_ruling', '3': 'ruling_does_not_import'} and a _ruling() called from check(). Tooth 1: cairn/machines/ruling, skills/ruled, bin/cmd/ruling and bin/cmd/ruled are absent under REPO, and Path.home()/'.claude'/'skills'/'ruled' neither exists nor is a symlink. Tooth 2: _naming over ('cairn.machines.' + 'ruling', 'cairn/machines/' + 'ruling', 'bin/cmd/' + 'ruling', 'bin/cmd/' + 'ruled', 'skills.' + 'ruled', 'skills/' + 'ruled', 'cairn ' + 'ruling', 'cairn ' + 'ruled') (each spelled split) finds nothing. Tooth 3: `import cairn.machines.ruling` and `import skills.ruled.door`, each in its own subprocess from REPO, exit nonzero with 'No module named'. The docstring gains a section for this ticket. The earlier tickets' teeth are unchanged. Run red before the build: all three FAIL.

D2: delete cairn/machines/ruling/ whole, skills/ruled/ whole, bin/cmd/ruling and bin/cmd/ruled: each intention+why.json, history.json, state.json and validations/*.json leaves first through bin/cairn artifact remove <path> --why 'ticket 640a7a48e1c5: the ruling intake retires (Q#43)'; git rm the rest. Remove the host link ~/.claude/skills/ruled (a symlink into skills/ruled).

D3: cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py's ruling_refusal stops importing the machine and reads the frozen store itself: decisions dir = Path(os.environ['CAIRN_ROOTS_PARENT']) if set else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4], joined with 'CairnCommons'/'decisions'; each *.json that parses as a dict with kind == 'ruling' and the matching id is the record (an unparseable file is skipped, as before); unconfirmed → the NOT CONFIRMED sentence, saying `confirmed` was derived from his RULED marker by the retired intake; none → 'no ruling <id> in <dir>'. The docstring says the store is read directly and is read-only since ticket 640a7a48e1c5 (Q#43). cairn/devices/tester/quorum.py lines 48 and 80 stop naming the intake command: decisions/ is the frozen store the retired intake wrote, and the refusal says the rule is lifted by a ruling on file there.

D4: cairn/tools/system_word/proofs/test_system_word.py: delete test_the_real_ruling_list_takes_uppercase, test_ruling_cli_takes_uppercase_list and test_lowercase_ruled_confirms_at_intake_and_ruledx_does_not; drop PROVES keys '7', 'ruling_cli' and 'marker'; test_the_three_charters_say_the_words_fold drops the ruling-charter assert and its docstring says two charters stand (system_word's and bin's), ruling's having left with its code.
